# semaphore_ex_kubernetes_execution_policy_test (Ephemeral Resource)

Evaluates a Kubernetes manifest summary against stored policy. No Job or other Kubernetes object is created. Opening this ephemeral resource evaluates the preview; results are not persisted in Terraform state. LDAP/OIDC previews record server-side reconciliation history. No automatic apply, renewal or deletion of audit history is performed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "semaphore_ex_kubernetes_execution_policy_test" "example" {
  cluster_alias = "jobs"
  request       = { namespace = "jobs", task_image = "example/image", service_account = "runner", has_restricted_security_profile = true }
}

# Reference ephemeral.semaphore_ex_kubernetes_execution_policy_test.example.result in an ephemeral context.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_alias` (String) Stored cluster policy alias.
- `request` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--request))

### Read-Only

- `result` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Complete native result, excluding any preview token. It is ephemeral and never stored in Terraform state. Sensitive because results may describe identity or execution metadata.
